_reference.paper: Wang et al., Automated multi-layer optical design via deep reinforcement learning, MLST 2 (2021) 025013, section 4.2
_reference.target: R=0 for 480-700 nm inclusive; R=1 outside that interval. Terminal-only reward, gamma=1, no logarithmic shaping.
_reference.wavelength_grid_note: 300-3000 nm follows the plotted spectral domain in Figure 7; 10 nm sampling is an explicit implementation choice, not a verified original Task 2 sampling step.
_reference.angle_grid_note: Paper reports averaging over 0-90 degrees. Use 0,1,...,89 degrees as a numerical approximation; exact 90 degrees is excluded by film_hppo and is a singular grazing-incidence limit. Original Task 2 angle step is not stated in the checked paper/code.
_reference.material_note: The paper says seven materials but lists six; SiN appears in Table 3 and is included here using the repository Si3N4.csv data. Dataset interpolation remains film_hppo linear, not original OML-PPO quadratic.
_reference.constraint_note: 45 maximum layers follows section 4.2. Continuous 15-400 nm thickness is an HPPO choice that contains Table 3 thicknesses; the exact Task 2 discrete thickness grid is not provided. No total-thickness cap is imposed.
_reference.objective_note: S is selected by each target quantity (R/T/A). score=1-sum(normalized_weight*mean(abs(S-S_target))); reward=score-sum(bound penalties) because reward_alpha=0. Current UV R:visible T:IR R weights are 1:2:1. Band-mean lower bounds are 0.70, 0.70, 0.85, each with squared-hinge penalty_weight=10; these are soft penalties, not hard guarantees. This score is not the visible-light enhancement factor chi.
_reference.training_note: Fresh HPPO/VAC initialization; no improvement checkpoint. learning_rate=5e-5 and n_sample=3000 follow reported values. DI-engine train iterations are not identical to paper epochs. Polarization uses an unpolarized s/p average.

_enhancement_note: reward=chi-constraint_penalty; score remains spectral score. Reflection-only model. Default original spectral reward is unchanged when reward_objective is absent or spectral. Stop/target values use penalized chi in enhancement mode.
